title: Work Light Bar 120W – 7 LED Spot & Flood
descriptionHtml:
Powerful work light when you need it

Working or driving in the dark without proper light is both difficult and unsafe. A good work light makes a big difference off-road and around the farm.

120W with spot and flood

This work light bar has 7 LEDs and 120W of power, with both spot and flood beams. It shines bright and fits off-road vehicles, SUVs and trucks.

Features

  • 120W with 7 LEDs
  • Combines spot and flood light
  • Strong, clear light
  • Durable for off-road use
  • Good for off-road vehicles, SUVs and trucks

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
